pages.text: $(t2)Tier 2$() raises the ceiling from 2x to $(bold)3x$() ore. The $(bold)Thermal Series$() Induction Smelter and Pulverizer are the mid-tier ore tier, producing alloys like Invar and Electrum.$(br2)Tier 2 also introduces real $(bold)power$(): a Stirling or Magmatic Dynamo feeds a Redstone Flux Cell - the grid every later tier draws on.

pages.title: Banking T2 tokens
pages.text: Thermal machine blocks are the richest T2 submissions: $(bold)Induction Smelter$() $(t2)50$(), $(bold)Pulverizer$() $(t2)40$() tokens each. Invar and Electrum mint per 50.$(br2)Bank $(t2)1000$() total to reach $(t3)Tier 3$(), where Mekanism unlocks. Full writeup: $(l:icraft:mods_t2/thermal)Thermal Series$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Next: build the Induction Smelter first — 50 tokens, and it smelts your Steel.$()
